verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's evidence covers marketing campaigns, flows, events, and SDKs, but there's no documentation of a dedicated transactional email API (e.g., a direct send-one-off-email endpoint for receipts or magic links) distinct from its flow/campaign marketing tooling. The closest reference (klaviyo-docs-17) describes event-triggered flow notifications for gift recipients, which is marketing-automation-based rather than a true one-to-one transactional send API.
